_comment: App Remoting package policy for Cross Device Resume (non-partner phone apps streamed to the PC via Phone Link). 'heroPackageIds' are the default-ON apps: when an App Remoting intent arrives for a hero with no AppRemotingListing row yet, the row is materialised ON, while every other non-partner app defaults OFF. The hero set is checksum-locked with the os.2020 Settings reader (PR 16579151) and the CrossDeviceResume writer; keep all copies identical. 'excludedPackageIds' are suppressed from the App Remoting taskbar flow even when otherwise eligible (non-partner, toggle on); this is in addition to partner-app precedence, since partner apps resume via their own dedicated toggle and are excluded by AppDetails.json membership. Seed and maintain the exclusion list from the spec / PM. All ids are raw Android package names.
